svg.aria-label: Scores: The model (SigLIP 2, ONNX, fp32) scores every label. The score of a topic is the sum of its labels. Response: The best label, its topic path, the top-k labels and the topics. Uncertain: uncertain turns true when the root topic score is too low. Read it before you trust the answer
